name: MSEntraID_GetRiskyUser
author: StrangeBee
description: Retrieve Microsoft Entra ID Identity Protection risk information for a user: current risk state (riskyUsers) and risk detection history (riskDetections). Requires Entra ID P1/P2.

configurationItems.name: client_id
configurationItems.description: Client ID/Application ID of Microsoft Entra ID Registered App

configurationItems.name: client_secret
configurationItems.description: Secret for Microsoft Entra ID Registered Application

configurationItems.name: lookup_range
configurationItems.description: Check for risk detections in the last X days. Should be between 1 and 90 days.

configurationItems.name: lookup_limit
configurationItems.description: Display no more than this many risk detections.
